_meta.description: D6 fixtures for claude-sdk-python / a2ui-recovery (A2UI error recovery)
_meta._note: Backend-owned A2UI (src/agents/recovery_agent.py, generate_a2ui, injectA2UITool=false) with a NATIVE validate->retry recovery loop made visible. claude-sdk-python uses its own adapter (ag-ui-claude-sdk + claude-agent-sdk) and re-implements the loop natively (it does NOT route through the shared ag_ui_langgraph toolkit). NO `context` match field anywhere: a real browser (the dojo) does NOT send the x-aimock-context header (only the test harness does), so context-scoped fixtures would 404 in-browser. The recovery pills' prompts are UNIQUE (they don't collide with the declarative-gen-ui a2ui_dynamic fixtures), so userMessage alone disambiguates. Flow per pill mirrors langgraph-python: the OUTER Claude call has one tool `generate_a2ui` and emits it (matched by userMessage; the inner-render fixtures are listed FIRST and carry toolName=render_a2ui so they win for the inner sub-agent calls, leaving the tool-less outer call to match the plain-userMessage fixture); the inner `render_a2ui` sub-agent is called once PER recovery attempt (matched by userMessage+toolName+sequenceIndex); the outer narration is matched by the emit's unique toolCallId (the follow-up's last user message is a tool_result block with no text, so userMessage matchers skip it). HEAL: attempt 1 (seq 0) invalid (root references a missing child) -> validate rejects -> retry -> attempt 2 (seq 1) valid -> paints (declarative-metric x2). EXHAUST: invalid on every attempt -> loop exhausts -> a2ui_recovery_exhausted envelope -> failed state ('Couldn't generate the UI'). Components MUST use the flat A2UI catalog shape.
